About Me

Building products that combine design, engineering & AI

I'm Ashok Kumar, a software developer focused on building intelligent web applications, AI-powered systems, and modern user experiences. I enjoy turning complex problems into scalable products that are fast, intuitive, and impactful.

My work spans full-stack development, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, automation systems, and modern frontend engineering. I care equally about performance, usability, and clean architecture.

What I Do
01 ⚙️

SMT Process Engineering

Paste setup, reflow profiling, yield optimisation, line balancing, and continuous process improvement across SMT lines.

02 🔬

Quality & Inspection

AOI, SPI, X-Ray analysis. IPC-A-610 inspection, defect root cause analysis, and corrective action workflows.

03 🖥️

Equipment & Programming

Pick & place programming, stencil design, feeder setup. Experience with Fuji, JUKI, and Heller reflow systems.

04 📋

NPI & Documentation

New product introduction, process documentation, FMEA, APQP, PPAP work instructions, and cross-functional team coordination.

Selected Projects
⚡ Project image

BOM Cost Intelligence Platform

Web application that ingests Bill of Materials (BOM) files, retrieves live component pricing from supplier APIs, calculates total manufacturing costs, identifies cost-saving opportunities, and exports professional quotation reports. Currently under active development.
